title: THE TOP SHELF
lesson: Asking is free, pride costs hours
caption: Too proud to ask for directions? THE RULE BOOK Ep 16: Clyde walked us round Paris for six hours instead of asking. Then he sat on a cafe table. One polite question to the waiter found page 6 in ten seconds. Who was the man in the suit? A) Solo B) Someone new. A or B? #liferules #lifelessons #stickman

lines: SIX HOURS LOST. STILL NOT ASKING!

lines.tr: SIX HEURES PERDUES. JE NE DEMANDE PAS !

lines: MONSIEUR. YOU SIT ON THE TABLE.

lines.tr: MONSIEUR. VOUS ÊTES ASSIS SUR LA TABLE.

lines: LE PROF? HIS PAGE IS ON MY TOP SHELF.

lines.tr: LE PROF ? SA PAGE EST SUR MON ÉTAGÈRE DU HAUT.

lines: PAGE 6: RULES FOR LIFE. NOT MONEY.

lines.tr: PAGE 6 : RÈGLES DE VIE. PAS D'ARGENT.

lines: ASKING IS FREE. PRIDE COSTS HOURS.

lines.tr: DEMANDER EST GRATUIT. L'ORGUEIL COÛTE DES HEURES.

lines: A MAN IN A SUIT ASKED TOO. YEARS AGO.

lines.tr: UN HOMME EN COSTUME A DEMANDÉ AUSSI. IL Y A DES ANNÉES.

lines: CLYDE STILL WON'T ASK FOR THE TOILET.

lines.tr: CLYDE NE DEMANDE TOUJOURS PAS LES TOILETTES.
